# KIDazzle Child Care & Learning - LLM Directory Context

KIDazzle Child Care provides elite early childhood education, GA DECAL licensed preschools, and toddler developmental care across Georgia, Tennessee, and Florida.

## Key Program Curriculums
- Infants: Sensory play, cognitive milestones, physical stimulation.
- Toddlers: Motor skills, vocabulary expansion, interactive playing.
- Pre-K: High-performance school readiness curriculum, early mathematics, and social-emotional growth.
